## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.0.7

More places to reach, and "destroy all" contracts that end when the enemy does.

- **Reach contracts on more maps:** nine Instant Action maps on Pirate's Moon's and MechWarrior 3's worlds now offer a contract to reach a nav point. Each point has a walkable way there that keeps clear of where the enemy starts, and each one has been driven to in testing with the enemy alive. On some you will be shot at on the way.
- **Routes keep clear of the drop-offs:** two Pirate's Moon worlds destroy any 'Mech that falls far enough below the ground. Reach routes and nav points now keep well back from those ravines, so you won't slide off a ledge cutting a corner on the way.
- **Wider mission areas on five Pirate's Moon maps:** the out-of-bounds lines are drawn around the new nav points too, so every point sits well inside them.
- **"Destroy all" contracts no longer end when the map's base falls:** on the third Instant Action maps, the map's own "base destroyed" rule could end the battle while enemies were still standing. On "destroy all" contracts the battle now goes on until the enemy is beaten or you are. Leaving the mission area still fails you, and defend contracts still fail if the base you defend falls.
- **Its own download:** MechWarrior 1 Remake now has packages of its own on this page, for Windows, Mac and Linux. The launcher installs and updates it from here.
- **From Pirate's Moon 1.2.3:** a few sounds played at full volume whatever the sound slider said. They now follow it.
